entries.title: ⌘Z in the message box undoes what you typed, not one letter
entries.body: In the message box and a card's reply, ⌘Z now takes back what you typed since the cursor last moved, a line at a time, as in other Mac apps. Before, it took back one letter at a time. ⇧⌘Z puts it back.
entries.noPicture: Undo is a key: a still picture of the message box looks the same before and after the fix.
